title: feat(app-shell): Studio uses shared picklists — select-field picker, served options left out of object saves, read-only picklist page (objectui#10202)
body:
Fixes #10202

Clause-②: no

Studio now reads shared picklists, the objectui half of objectstack#18164 phase 2, scoped by ruling 6006062645 (A′) items (a)–(c). Item (d), the studio-authoring checklist item, lives in objectstack; its ready-to-file text is in the `os-dev-report` comment on objectui#10202, for the seat to file.

Dispatched work: claim 6007167258, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_015W8GBu6sBiqus2L2xjMsAL`.

## What changes

**(a) "Use picklist" in the select-field editor** (`inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`, shared by the metadata-admin object designer and the Studio data page).
- For a `select`, `radio`, `multiselect` or `checkboxes` field, an **Options from** picker (the existing `InspectorSelectField`, a closed list) offers "This field's own options" and every picklist `GET /meta/picklist` serves, by name. The roster loads through `usePickerLoad`, with its loaders held in state once per mount (`3114a9f`), so a failed read is its own state: the picker says so and still offers the field's own options. A stored name the served list no longer carries is drawn flagged "(not found)".
- Choosing a picklist sets `picklist` and removes `options` outright. Choosing the field's own options removes `picklist` and the served copy of the options.
- A bound field **refuses inline options**: the inline options editor is not offered. In its place the field's values are listed read-only, with the reason. The values are the served field's resolved copy when the draft carries one, else the list's own options from the roster, with a note that values other packages add are offered too (`GET /meta/picklist` does not merge extensions). The default-value picker offers the same values.
- A retype to a type the spec lets name no picklist drops the binding. The test is the installed spec's `SINGLE_OPTION_TYPES` ∪ `MULTI_OPTION_TYPES`, not a re-listed set.

**(b) Served options left out of the object PUT** (`metadata-admin/picklist-binding.ts`, `dropServedPicklistOptions`).
- Every field whose `picklist` is set leaves without `options`, not only the edited field. Nothing else is touched: a field without `picklist` keeps its inline `options` byte-identical, and so does every other key. The function is pure and returns the same reference when there is nothing to drop.
- Applied where a designer that hosts the select-field editor builds its PUT. The metadata-admin object designer gets it as the `object` resource's `fromDraft` in `services/builtinComponents.tsx`, the `page` resource's `pageSaveBody` precedent. The Studio data page applies it at its two object PUTs that re-send the served buffer: the draft autosave and the column reorder.
- The metadata-admin live Zod pass now judges `fromDraft(draft)` in edit mode, the body `doSave` sends. Before, it showed "`picklist` and `options` cannot both be declared" on load for every object with a served bound field, measured below. `fromDraft` is read from the registry by `type`, so no memoised identity keys the effect.
- ⛔ Not applied at the transport. `MetadataClient.save` cannot tell a served copy from an author who wrote both keys, and the second has to stay a loud refusal. The writers this PR does not touch are listed under Acceptance notes.

**(c) The picklist page is read-only** (`previews/PicklistPreview.tsx`, registered in `previews/index.ts`; reader in `previews/picklist-extensions.ts`).
- The kind's `/meta/types` row declares `allowRuntimeCreate: false` and `allowOrgOverride: false`, and the generic list and edit pages already honour it. So this adds no read-only mechanism of its own: it registers the detail view.
- The detail view shows the label, name, description and owning package (`_packageId`), each option with its label and value, and each extension under the package that declares it. It offers no create, edit or delete.
- Extensions are read from `GET /meta/package`, where each manifest carries its `picklistExtensions` as authored. The list's own read does not serve them. A failed package read says the extensions are unknown, never that there are none.

## Live measurement

objectstack `main` `faf8dce4` in its own worktree, showcase booted `--fresh`. The console was served from this branch. The stock showcase declares no picklist, so a local, **uncommitted** fixture was added to that worktree only: picklist `showcase_priority_tier` (Gold, Silver, Bronze), one `picklistExtensions` entry (Platinum), and one bound field on `showcase_account`. Writable objects `acme_account` (field `tier` bound) and `acme_contact` (field `segment` inline) were created in a runtime package `com.acme.crm`.

| reading | result |
|---|---|
| `GET /meta/picklist`, `GET /meta/picklist/NAME` | name, label, description, own options, `_packageId`; **no extension** |
| `GET /meta/object/acme_account/layers` `effective.fields.tier` | `picklist` + 4 resolved options (Platinum included) |
| **before**: that served body PUT back with an edited description | **422** `INVALID_METADATA` at `fields.tier.options` |
| control: the same body with only `tier.options` removed | 200 |
| today's tree, metadata-admin designer on a served bound field | live issue "Fields → priority_tier → options: `picklist` and `options` cannot both be declared…" on load |
| **after**, metadata-admin designer: rename an unrelated field's label (autosave) | PUT **200**; `tier` sent as `{type, label, picklist}`; inline `status` options intact; no live issue on load |
| after, `acme_contact.segment`: Options from → Priority Tier | picker listed "This field's own options" + "Priority Tier (showcase_priority_tier)"; PUT **200** with `picklist` and no `options`; "Add value" 1 → 0 |
| after, Studio data page on `acme_account`: add a field (autosave) | PUT **200**, `tier` without `options` |
| after publish, new-record forms of both objects | each bound select offers Gold, Silver, Bronze, Platinum |
| after, picklist page | owning package, options, "Added by ObjectStack Showcase (com.example.showcase)" → Platinum; every control disabled or read-only, zero write requests (same on today's tree: no create on the list, disabled form) |

## Tests

New pins, each read off the wire or the real component:
- `metadata-admin/picklist-binding.test.ts`
- `inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.usePicklist-10202.test.tsx`
- `metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.picklistServedOptions-10202.test.tsx`, real edit page, real `MetadataClient`, a transport that refuses the served pair as the door does
- `studio-design/DataPillar.picklistServedOptions-10202.test.tsx`, both Studio PUTs
- `previews/PicklistPreview.test.tsx`, fed the measured package-row shape
- `metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.picklistReadOnly-10202.test.tsx`, the generic route offers no create, edit or delete

Ablations through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode, run from the committed trees `3019cff`/`1d8c6c2`, and A9 on `3114a9f`). Each one: landing proven by anchor count and blob change; restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| id | mutation | red |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | drop the `object` `fromDraft` | the PUT pin (`expected 422 to be 200` at `fields.tier.options` and `fields.regions.options`), the advisory pin, the registration pin |
| A2 | live pass judges the raw draft | the advisory pin only (1 of 3) |
| A3a | Studio autosave sends `objDraft` | the autosave pin only (422) |
| A3b | Studio reorder sends `body` | the reorder pin only (422) |
| A4 | binding keeps `options` | the bind and unbind pins |
| A5 | inline editor shown on a bound field | the two bound-view pins |
| A6 | retype keeps `picklist` | the retype pin |
| A7 | extensions not filtered by `extend` | the extension-filter and reader pins |
| A8 | the strip drops `options` from every field | 6 pins across the helper, edit-page and Studio files |
| A9 | the roster loader back to a client-keyed `useMemo` | the `usePicklist` pins and the existing `ObjectFieldInspector.optionLabel` suite hang (killed by `timeout 120`, exit 124) |

The first A3 attempt was a no-op: its replacement text was a substring of the anchor, so the tool refused before running anything. It was re-run with a distinct marker.

## Gates

Read on `3114a9f`, the final head, unless a line says otherwise (corrected by the seat at landing; this section was first written at `46320ed`, while the locked runs were still queued). Each exit code was written to a file before any pipe.

- The six new test files, run from the repo root (`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 FILE…`): **30 passed (30)**, exit 0.
- Root `check:*` gates, exit 0 each: `i18n-designer-parity`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `metadata-write-doors` (17 doors, 3 object-capable, all guarded), `new-line-citations` (0 new), `control-bytes`, `test-path-roots`, `vi-mock-specifiers`, `vi-mock-inherit`, `vi-mock-override-shape`, `changeset-claims`, `pending-changeset-literals`, `unreferenced-sources`, `spec-symbols`, `installed-pin-claims`, `phantom-deps`. `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` also exit 0.
- Under the shared verify lock, on `3114a9f`:
  - `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check`, `lint` and `build`: exit 0 each.
  - The full `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/`, as two `--shard` runs: 1/2 `Test Files 509 passed | 1 skipped (510)`, `Tests 4662 passed | 9 skipped (4671)`; 2/2 `Test Files 510 passed (510)`, `Tests 5423 passed (5423)`. Together 1019 of 1020 files passed and 1 skipped.
  - The `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure build ran on the pre-merge tree: exit 0. The merge brought no declaration change.
- **Clause-② fence**, on the `3114a9f` build:
  - Walked every `.d.ts` reachable from `packages/app-shell/dist/index.d.ts` through relative specifiers: 150 files.
  - None names `dropServedPicklistOptions`, `PicklistPreview`, `extensionsOf`, `shownOptions`, `PicklistExtensionRow`, `ShownOption`, `usePicklistRoster`, `fetchPicklistRoster`, `PicklistSourceField`, `BoundPicklistOptions`, `takesPicklist` or `PicklistRosterEntry`.
  - Positive controls: `registerMetadataResource` and `SupportedLocale` are both found.
  - `i18n.d.ts` is reachable, and it carries none of the new copy keys. Control: an existing key is absent from it too; the new key is present in the emitted `i18n.js`.
  - No exported type, prop or member changed.
- **An earlier full run had no verdict.** The first, unsharded attempt was killed by the cgroup OOM killer after 28 min, with vitest at 7.8 GB anon RSS. The cause was this PR's own render loop: the picklist roster loader was a `useMemo` keyed on the client, and `usePickerLoad` re-entered `loading` on each new loader. `3114a9f` holds the loaders in state once per mount and pins it (A9); the two shards above ran after that fix.
- **Not run locally:** `check:eager-closure`. It weighs a built console bundle; CI's performance-budget job runs it. This PR adds the picklist preview to the eager metadata-admin registrations.

## Acceptance notes

- **Remaining object writers re-send the served options (family, for the seat).** Measured: Studio → Access → OWD overview (`?surface=owd:overview`), change `acme_account`'s sharing model and Save. The PUT came back **422** at `fields.tier.options`, with the server's prescription on screen. By reading, the same shape exists in `views/runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` (two object saves), plugin-designer `MetadataFieldsPage` / `MetadataObjectsPage`, and `MetadataService.saveObject` / `saveFields` / `saveMetadataItem`. None of them is touched by this PR, so none is changed here. The fix shape is the same `dropServedPicklistOptions` at each writer that seeds from a served read.
- The designer canvas draws a just-bound select with no options: the canvas reads the field's own `options`. Runtime forms show the list's options (measured above).
- The picklist page's inspector pane is the generic engine's read-only form: every control is disabled (measured), the same rendering every locked kind gets.
